entries.name: createChart
entries.note: Options are flat (rightMargin, grid, crosshair, overrides), not layout/timeScale objects; see the option entries. Resizes with its container by itself.

entries.name: createYieldCurveChart
entries.note: No yield curve chart; TradeCanvas charts bars over time.

entries.name: createOptionsChart
entries.note: No price-based horizontal scale; TradeCanvas charts bars over time.

entries.name: chart.addSeries
entries.note: One main series per chart: pick its type ('candlestick', 'line', 'area', 'bar', 'baseline'...). More lines: compare symbols or indicators.

entries.name: chart.addCandlestickSeries
entries.note: setChartType('candlestick') (the default). Data goes to chart.setData(bars).

entries.name: chart.addBarSeries
entries.note: setChartType('bar').

entries.name: chart.addLineSeries
entries.note: setChartType('line') for the main series. An extra line: addCompareSymbol with OHLC bars, after setCompareMode('absolute') for prices, not percent.

entries.name: chart.addAreaSeries
entries.note: setChartType('area').

entries.name: chart.addBaselineSeries
entries.note: setChartType('baseline').

entries.name: chart.addHistogramSeries
entries.note: Volume is drawn from each bar's volume field, no second series. Other histograms: an indicator (chart.addIndicator or registerIndicator).

entries.name: chart.addCustomSeries
entries.note: Custom drawing goes through an indicator plugin (or chart.registerDrawingTool for a tool), not a custom series view.

entries.name: chart.removeSeries
entries.note: The main series cannot be removed; chart.setMainSeriesVisible(false) hides it.

entries.name: series.setData
entries.note: Bar time is MILLISECONDS (OHLCBar.time), LWC uses seconds or 'YYYY-MM-DD': multiply by 1000. Bars need open, high, low, close, volume; line data: set all four to value.

entries.name: series.update
entries.note: updateLastBar for the same time, appendBar for a newer bar; time in ms, not seconds. An older bar (historicalUpdate): chart.updateBar(bar).

entries.name: series.pop
entries.note: No pop: set the bars again without the last ones (chart.getData().slice(0, -n)).

entries.name: series.data
entries.note: Times in ms.

entries.name: series.dataByIndex
entries.note: Index the array: chart.getData()[i].

entries.name: series.lastValueData
entries.note: Take the last bar's close.

entries.name: series.applyOptions
entries.note: Colours and widths are style keys ('series.candlestick.upColor', 'series.line.color'); the price format is chart.setPriceFormat.

entries.name: series.options
entries.note: The resolved style keys.

entries.name: series.priceToCoordinate
entries.note: No public price to pixel conversion.

entries.name: series.coordinateToPrice
entries.note: No public pixel to price conversion; crosshairMove and chartContextMenu payloads carry prices.

entries.name: series.createPriceLine
entries.note: A horizontalLine drawing: addDrawing({ type: 'horizontalLine', anchors: [{ time, price }], style }). Returns its id, not a line object.

entries.name: series.priceLines
entries.note: Filter by type 'horizontalLine'.

entries.name: series.setMarkers
entries.note: Signal markers need time (ms), price, direction 'long'/'short'/'neutral', confidence, source. Marks are badges at the pane's foot (time ms, title).

entries.name: createSeriesMarkers
entries.note: Markers are set on the chart, not a series plugin. Time in ms; arrows above/below become direction 'short'/'long'.

entries.name: series.priceScale
entries.note: Scale settings are chart methods: setScaleMode, setLogScale, setInvertScale, setAutoScale.

entries.name: series.moveToPane
entries.note: Only indicators move between panes; the main series stays in the price pane.

entries.name: series.attachPrimitive
entries.note: Custom drawing is a drawing tool or indicator plugin, not a series primitive.

entries.name: chart.applyOptions
entries.note: No deep options object after creation: colours and lines are style keys; the rest are setters (setCrosshairMode, setLogScale, setGridVisible...).

entries.name: chart.options
entries.note: Style keys only; other state through getters (getCrosshairMode, isLogScale...).

entries.name: chart.timeScale
entries.note: No time scale object: its methods are on the chart (fitContent, setVisibleRange, scrollToEnd...).

entries.name: timeScale.setVisibleRange
entries.note: Two numbers in ms, not { from, to } in seconds.

entries.name: timeScale.getVisibleRange
entries.note: { from, to } in ms, or null.

entries.name: timeScale.setVisibleLogicalRange
entries.note: No logical range: pass the times of those bars, chart.getData()[i].time.

entries.name: timeScale.getVisibleLogicalRange
entries.note: No getter of bar indices; the visibleRangeChange payload carries them.

entries.name: timeScale.scrollToPosition
entries.note: Scrolls by a count of bars from where it is, not to a position from the right edge.

entries.name: timeScale.resetTimeScale
entries.note: Goes back to the newest bar; chart.fitContent() shows all bars.

entries.name: timeScale.subscribeVisibleTimeRangeChange
entries.note: Payload from/to are bar indices, not times: chart.getData()[from].time, or call chart.getVisibleTimeRange().

entries.name: timeScale.subscribeVisibleLogicalRangeChange
entries.note: Payload from/to are bar indices.

entries.name: timeScale.subscribeSizeChange
entries.note: The whole chart's size, not the time scale's.

entries.name: timeScale.timeToCoordinate
entries.note: No public time to pixel conversion.

entries.name: timeScale.coordinateToTime
entries.note: No public pixel to time conversion; crosshairMove carries the time.

entries.name: timeScale.applyOptions
entries.note: Set rightMargin, minBarSpacing, maxBarSpacing at construction; at runtime use setAutoScroll, setPanLimits.

entries.name: chart.subscribeCrosshairMove
entries.note: Payload { point, bar, barIndex, time (ms), indicatorValues }; crosshairLeave fires when it leaves.

entries.name: chart.subscribeClick
entries.note: click gives { x, y }; barClick gives the bar, its index and point.

entries.name: chart.subscribeDblClick
entries.note: No chart double-click event; drawingDoubleClick fires on drawings only.

entries.name: chart.setCrosshairPosition
entries.note: setCrosshairTime takes a time in ms; setCrosshairPosition takes { x, y } in pixels.

entries.name: chart.clearCrosshairPosition
entries.note: Pass null.

entries.name: chart.resize
entries.note: Takes no size: it reads the container's. The chart already follows its container on its own.

entries.name: chart.takeScreenshot
entries.note: A PNG data URL (sync) or Blob (async), not a canvas.

entries.name: chart.priceScale
entries.note: No price scale object; scale settings are chart methods.

entries.name: priceScale.applyOptions
entries.note: No scaleMargins setting.

entries.name: chart.addPane
entries.note: Panes come with indicators that need one; no empty panes.

entries.name: chart.removePane
entries.note: A pane goes when its last indicator is removed.

entries.name: chart.swapPanes
entries.note: Moves one pane up (-1) or down (1).

entries.name: chart.chartElement
entries.note: No getter; it is the container you passed to new Chart().

entries.name: chart.autoSizeActive
entries.note: Always on: the chart follows its container.

entries.name: autoSize
entries.note: Not needed: the chart always follows its container's size.

entries.name: layout.background
entries.note: A colour; LWC's { type, color } object becomes its color. No gradient background.

entries.name: layout.textColor
entries.note: Set on each part.

entries.name: layout.fontSize
entries.note: Font is { family, sizeSmall, sizeMedium, sizeLarge }; or chart.setFont().

entries.name: layout.fontFamily
entries.note: Font is { family, sizes }; or chart.setFont().

entries.name: layout.attributionLogo
entries.note: No attribution logo.

entries.name: grid.vertLines.style
entries.note: Line styles are names ('solid', 'dashed', 'dotted'), not LineStyle numbers.

entries.name: grid.horzLines.style
entries.note: Line styles are names, not numbers.

entries.name: crosshair.mode
entries.note: crosshair: { mode: 'normal' | 'magnet' | 'hidden' } instead of CrosshairMode numbers 0/1/2; or chart.setCrosshairMode(mode).

entries.name: crosshair.vertLine.style
entries.note: Line style names, not numbers.

entries.name: crosshair.vertLine.labelBackgroundColor
entries.note: One label colour for both axes.

entries.name: crosshair.horzLine.style
entries.note: Line style names, not numbers.

entries.name: crosshair.horzLine.labelBackgroundColor
entries.note: One label colour for both axes.

entries.name: timeScale.rightOffset
entries.note: Empty bar slots past the newest bar, as in LWC.

entries.name: timeScale.barSpacing
entries.note: No starting bar spacing; bound the zoom with minBarSpacing and maxBarSpacing.

entries.name: timeScale.visible
entries.note: timeAxis: { visible }.

entries.name: timeScale.timeVisible
entries.note: No switch: the axis shows times on intraday charts by itself; a timeFormatter changes the text.

entries.name: timeScale.secondsVisible
entries.note: No switch; write seconds in a timeFormatter.

entries.name: timeScale.fixLeftEdge
entries.note: freePan: false stops panning past the data; panLimits.minVisibleBars bounds it otherwise.

entries.name: timeScale.fixRightEdge
entries.note: freePan: false keeps the newest bar at its resting place.

entries.name: rightPriceScale.visible
entries.note: priceAxis: { visible }.

entries.name: rightPriceScale.mode
entries.note: Names, not PriceScaleMode numbers: 0 'regular', 1 'logarithmic', 2 'percentage', 3 'indexedTo100'. Chart.logScale starts in log.

entries.name: rightPriceScale.scaleMargins
entries.note: No scale margins.

entries.name: leftPriceScale.visible
entries.note: It mirrors the right scale unless overlays are put on it (addIndicator(..., { scale: 'left' })).

entries.name: handleScroll
entries.note: One switch; no separate mouse wheel, drag and touch settings.

entries.name: handleScale
entries.note: One switch; no separate wheel, pinch and axis drag settings.

entries.name: kineticScroll
entries.note: No kinetic scroll setting.

entries.name: trackingMode
entries.note: No tracking mode setting.

entries.name: localization.locale
entries.note: A BCP 47 locale for numbers and dates.

entries.name: localization.priceFormatter
entries.note: Takes a formatter or a fraction setting.

entries.name: localization.timeFormatter
entries.note: Gets times in ms.

entries.name: localization.dateFormat
entries.note: No date format string; write it in a timeFormatter.

entries.name: watermark
entries.note: { text, color, fontSize }; one line of text, no alignment options.

entries.name: series.upColor
entries.note: Each chart type has its own keys (series.bar.upColor...).

entries.name: series.borderUpColor
entries.note: No separate border colour; bodies use upColor.

entries.name: series.borderDownColor
entries.note: No separate border colour; bodies use downColor.

entries.name: series.color
entries.note: For a line series.

entries.name: series.lineWidth
entries.note: For a line series; series.area.lineWidth for an area.

entries.name: series.topLineColor
entries.note: Baseline series: above the base.

entries.name: series.bottomLineColor
entries.note: Baseline series: below the base.

entries.name: series.priceLineStyle
entries.note: Line style names, not numbers.

entries.name: series.priceLineColor
entries.note: Coloured by direction; set both for one colour.

entries.name: series.priceFormat
entries.note: Chart-wide; or chart.setPriceFormat().
